messages:
Nina: Quick Q — onboarding external consultant from ConsultCo. They only need to validate our redaction rules on telemetry logs in the dev project. What's the least privilege we can give for a one-day window? Not comfortable giving Project Viewer.
Elias: Can we do ephemeral access (JIT) + dataset-level view? Prefer not to expose raw logs in Logging UI. Common pattern: export the redacted logs to a dedicated BigQuery dataset and grant bigquery.dataViewer to the ephemeral SA.
Nina: Hmm we already have a dev-logs-bq dataset with redacted export. Would that work if we create a short-lived SA? Steps?
Samir: +1 to BigQuery approach. Create SA, grant bigquery.dataViewer on dataset, grant storage.objectViewer if using sink to GCS. Don't give roles/logging.viewer.
Elias: Steps (high level):
```
# create SA
gcloud iam service-accounts create consultant-ephemeral --project=redwood-dev
# grant dataset access
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-dev --member=\"serviceAccount:consultant-ephemeral@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" --role=\"roles/bigquery.dataViewer\"\n# optional: set up short-lived key / impersonation
# prefer impersonation via iamcredentials.generateAccessToken for no long-lived keys
```
Nina: Do we need approval workflow? We want audit trail and expiration.
Samir: Use access-bot JIT request. We'll log the ticket id and put duration 24h. Security will require justification and attach the prompt set they will run.
access-bot: JIT request created — ID: JIT-202403-847. Approvers: Samir, Elias. Expires in 24h.
Elias: Also ensure the dataset has only redacted fields — don't include raw_message. If you're unsure run quick query to confirm.
Nina: Got it. I'll open the JIT request and attach the sample queries. Thanks :thumbsup:
Samir: If they need to run ad-hoc SQL, grant bigquery.jobUser on the project scope for the SA but limit to dataset with IAM; prefer dataset-level.
